title: The verdict letters are the keep rule's own alphabet: all five checks are fixed before the run (coverage, precision, margin, sign test, flips) and all pass
The margin rests on a weak comparator: identifier-overlap only catches backticked-token loss, right on 13/40 where flag-nothing is right on 9/40
A=35 is relative superiority: precision 26/26 = 1.00 but recall 26/31 = 0.839, with all 5 misses being false negatives on drifted rows
The 121-line calls.jsonl plus the 40-row labels file replay the published column exactly (M=40 A=35 TP=26 FP=0 F=3) with no model in the loop
Constructed rows are not the easy half: live Jev-right 19/20 vs constructed 16/20; all five misses sit at probability 0.49-0.78 and three are threshold-adjacent
p=2.384e-7 is exactly 2^-22, the exact sign test over W=22 L=0; it measures superiority over the baseline on disagreement rows, not accuracy against labels
F=3 is three 2-1 rerun splits (constructed-02/04/09), all within 0.06 of the 0.5 flag line; no live row flipped and one supports rerun sits at exactly 0.5
The row set is 9 supports / 31 drifted (20 construction-labeled), which sets the prevalence the baseline and the margin are scored against

direction: Construction rows inflate the headline accuracy
reason: The kind split shows the opposite: Jev is right on 16/20 constructed rows and 19/20 live rows, and all five of its misses are constructed-or-live false negatives concentrated at the threshold
